The writing donors (write:) were read at their pinned commits by the 2026-10-30 sub-skill reads (writing.json), which re-hashed all 94 source files; the docs items from the new-tools reads (new:, new-a.json and new-b.json) and the UI-copy idea from the design read (design:, design-b.json) likewise. taken.mechanism: WD-8: scan the project's own docs, publish raw and exempted counts, ceilings that only move down; WD-9: a gate's threshold comes from the project's own human-written docs, a hashed corpus stops the run when changed, no rate below n of 100 or from one register, and unscannable input exits 2.

rejected: Vocabulary ban lists and the numeric word-list gates as rules: taste that dates, which the catalogue itself calls inherited, not measured (patterns.md:72).
Stylometric detectors and the 0 to 100 composite score: the repository's own corpus put paragraph ROC-AUC at 0.501 (PROOF.md:111-116), and type-token ratio has a length confound.
Default replacement tables (robust to strong and the like): lossy in technical docs.
A hard em-dash maximum: taste, and the skill itself says a dash is not authorship evidence; only a repository's own house style may ban it.
The seven-skill router, the mandatory read of a 120 KB catalogue before every pass, and the social, launch-copy and voice-profile rules.
Erroring on any heading-count change: westack-docs expects it in revise-structure and ties each such finding to the user's request instead.
